description: Department of Local Government North-Western Province - Rules for the Preparations and enforcement of MC, UC & PS Budgets-2020 in North-Western Province
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the publication of new rules ("Rules for the Preparation and Enforcement of Municipal Council Budgets 2020") under the Municipal Council Ordinance. It establishes regulatory procedures and compliance requirements for municipal budget preparation, submission, and approval processes. The content focuses on legal/regulatory framework creation rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or any of the other specialized categories.
